licence: Every painter in WebXR/shared/textures.js draws its face procedurally, from canvas fills, gradients and Math.random() — nothing here is generated or downloaded, and none of the sixteen tiles below ship a file. A deployment that later generates or licenses a real photographic or PBR tile for a painter may drop it at assets/textures/<id>.jpg and set that entry's `file` to the filename, with the tile's own `licence` and `provenance` recorded on the same entry — facePaint() then loads that file instead of drawing the canvas for that painter's id (see docs/textures.md, "Drop-in tiles"). tools/check_textures.mjs fails the build on an entry whose `file` is set without both, on a shipped file with no entry, and on an entry for a file that is not actually present.
